title: vernonia cinerea
intro: Vernonia cinerea, commonly known as Grey Ironweed, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to treat fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and protect against oxidative stress. Vernonia cinerea contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
